512-2872-4188.easyPrerequisites: Accomplished Alchemist and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
512-2872-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
512-2872-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Accomplished Alchemist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-2872-4188.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Accomplished Alchemist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

147-1893-2921.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1893-2921.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-4488-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-4488-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4050-4871-6476-7874.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4050-4871-6476-7874.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning The Immortal Weapons and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When The Immortal Weapons enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including The Immortal Weapons, adding {4}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3276-5038-5256-7707.description:
When an opponent controls a nontoken creature, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When the opposing creature(s) die, Overseer of the Damned triggers that many times, creating that many tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that will have deathtouch due to Archetype of Finality.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat as needed.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4373-4478.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4373-4478.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3490-4369-7307.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-3490-4369-7307.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Raphael triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Raphael triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Raphael trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-3129-6463.description:
Activate Meticulous Artisan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Meticulous Artisan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Meticulous Artisan.
Resolve the Meticulous Artisan trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2653-5702--143.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
2653-5702--143.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2653-5702--143.description:
Earthbend a land, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the land it is attached to.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Nissa and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.

3480-3490-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3480-3490-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3967-5541-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a coin counter on it

1349-4050-6863--133.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
1349-4050-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Repeat from step 2.

2585-2957-3767-3918.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Grim Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2018-2438-3826.easyPrerequisites: Medicine Runner does not have a flying counter on it.
2018-2438-3826.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Medicine Runner.
When Medicine Runner dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Medicine Runner from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Medicine Runner enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Medicine Runner.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-3455-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Vizier of Many Faces has a power of at least 2.
1912-3455-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Vizier of Many Faces and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Vizier of Many Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Vizier of Many Faces to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Vizier of Many Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Vizier of Many Faces by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2187-3617-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2187-3617-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

4050-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4050-5776-5777.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature, adding one mana of any color
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
4050-5776-5777.notes: If you have mana available, you may instead sacrifice the creatures using Camellia's ability.

1525-2031-2406-2660-3504.notablePrerequisites:
Mercurial Pretender is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3504.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3504.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

804-1558-3529-4231.notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima the Impostor is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
804-1558-3529-4231.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

215-729-2404-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other creatures.
215-729-2404-4644.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Tidewater Minion's second ability by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more creatures, this combo will net infinite green mana, which you then may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Tidewater Minion any number of times.

2034-5003-5374.description:
Whenever an opponent controls a creature, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Keiga, adding {C}{C}.
When Keiga dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Keiga trigger, causing you to gain control of a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature you gained control of in step 3, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Keiga from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat as desired and/or whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2792-3403-3489.notablePrerequisites:
Ingenious Infiltrator does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}{B}.
2792-3403-3489.description:
Declare Ingenious Infiltrator as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Ingenious Infiltrator from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Ingenious Infiltrator's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{B} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Ingenious Infiltrator onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-969-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-969-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1692-1803-3951-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Éomer.
Kari Zev does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1692-1803-3951-4050.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Éomer with haste.
Declare Kari Zev as an attacker.
Kari Zev triggers, creating a legendary 2/1 Ragavan creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ragavan, adding {1}.
When Ragavan dies, each Éomer that hasn't triggered this turn triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get at least one additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1368-2172.description:
Cast Burning Inquiry by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Burning Inquiry, causing each player to draw three cards and discard three cards at random.
Cast Burning Inquiry from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling 3 cards from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2427-2556-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
